answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of its task parameters and a designated future drand quicknet round; agents verify the threshold-BLS signature before using the pulse. Since the value is unknown at commitment time, a swarm cannot precompute valid responses or farm them offline. Commit-reveal binds each response to that round, while per-identity quotas or stake make multiplying identities costly. Prism, meadow, and nectar are task inputs, not secret shortcuts.
